issues.description: Cycles A–G were not independently observed RED. All cycle tests were authored up front; Cycle 1 RED was only ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND; the first implementation already included extract success, new-file ceiling, rename, exemptions, generated globs, git-show hunks, and CLI wiring, so later Expected RED states never failed on their named heuristic. Process observation only; GWT coverage remains intact. Unfixed from cycle 1.

Cycle F integration coverage is thinner than the packet text: the test named whitespace-only and import-only only commits an import-specifier change (no real-git whitespace hunk; no rename old-path hunk). The BoardContext grandfather CLI case uses a README-only repo and never creates an unmodified BoardContext.tsx. Production still only walks git-diff entries, so the DELIVERABLE 'not in the diff' Then holds. The new C<100 copy-with-edit collector test does not close these gaps.

Whitespace-only exemption requires 1:1 paired added/removed lines with equal collapsed text (line-budget.mjs:68-77). Adding or deleting a blank line on an oversized file would classify as a touch and could demand a split. Paired format hunks in Cycle D pass; this is a heuristic edge, not a missed DELIVERABLE scenario. Unfixed from cycle 1.
